basic_profile.bio: I'm a 40-something lover of all things 80s, especially movies and music. Born and raised in the Midwest, I spent a few years in the Navy, which is where my love for 'Flight of the Intruder' comes from. I currently work as a school psychologist, helping kids navigate their educational journeys. I'm married with two kids and enjoy spending my free time gardening and exploring new hobbies like pickling. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after the kids are asleep or during my lunch break at work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a school psychologist with a decade of experience, I have a strong background in educational psychology and child development. My time in the Navy has also given me a unique perspective on military life and history. Over the years, I've become adept at self-teaching through online resources and communities, especially when diving into new hobbies.
